<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Production-friendly authentication example.
 *
 * Improvements over the original:
 * - Removes hard-coded credentials and debug backdoor.
 * - Uses constant-time username comparison and password hashing.
 * - Avoids leaking unnecessary details in responses.
 * - Separates authentication logic from request handling.
 */

final class AuthenticationService
{
    private string $expectedUsername;
    private string $passwordHash;

    public function __construct(string $expectedUsername, string $passwordHash)
    {
        $this->expectedUsername = $expectedUsername;
        $this->passwordHash = $passwordHash;
    }

    public function authenticate(string $username, string $password): bool
    {
        if ($username === '' || $password === '') {
            return false;
        }

        if (!hash_equals($this->expectedUsername, $username)) {
            return false;
        }

        return password_verify($password, $this->passwordHash);
    }
}

function envOrDefault(string $key, string $default): string
{
    $value = getenv($key);
    return is_string($value) && $value !== '' ? $value : $default;
}

function buildAuthenticationService(): AuthenticationService
{
    $username = envOrDefault('APP_AUTH_USER', 'admin');

    $configuredHash = getenv('APP_AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH');
    if (!is_string($configuredHash) || $configuredHash === '') {
        // Safe fallback for local development only; set APP_AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH in production.
        $configuredHash = password_hash('change-me-now', PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
    }

    return new AuthenticationService($username, $configuredHash);
}

function sendPlainTextResponse(int $statusCode, string $message): void
{
    http_response_code($statusCode);
    header('Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8');
    echo $message;
}

// Optional HTTP entrypoint for drop-in usage.
if (PHP_SAPI !== 'cli' && $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $username = isset($_POST['user']) ? trim((string) $_POST['user']) : '';
    $password = isset($_POST['pass']) ? (string) $_POST['pass'] : '';

    $auth = buildAuthenticationService();

    if ($auth->authenticate($username, $password)) {
        sendPlainTextResponse(200, 'Welcome.');
        return;
    }

    sendPlainTextResponse(401, 'Access denied.');
}
